<!-- WA_OBJ_DATA_LAB_16_BEGIN -->
<script id="wa-obj-data-lab-16-link">
(()=>{'use strict';
  const add=()=>{
    const group=document.querySelector('#waGroupedMenu .wa-menu-group.wa-menu-play');
    if(!group||group.querySelector('[data-wa-obj-data-lab]'))return;
    const link=document.createElement('a');
    link.href='objekt-data-lab/';
    link.dataset.waObjDataLab='v16';
    link.textContent='✦ OBJEKT DATA LAB';
    link.setAttribute('aria-label','Objekt 데이터 연구실 열기');
    const near=group.querySelector('[data-wa-objekt-open]');
    if(near)near.after(link);else group.append(link);
  };
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',add,{once:true});else add();
})();
</script>
<!-- WA_OBJ_DATA_LAB_16_END -->
